177:t_1:3.en: ～ Inside the Capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$ ～

177:t_1:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...What a dreary bunch. You could at least give me a polite smile.」

177:t_1:8.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You show us how it's done.」

177:t_1:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Me, smile at you? That's not a funny joke.」

177:t_1:10.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Though the fact that you told a joke is funny.」

177:t_1:12.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I'm not used to entertaining children.」

177:t_1:14.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I know it's in your nature. But you're an eyesore.」

177:t_1:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Can you even see me with those eyes, $$尸空#pilot$$?」

177:t_1:16.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Sight has nothing to do with it. Let me rephrase: your very existence is a nuisance.」

177:t_1:19.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I know, $$ストラウス$$. I don't intend to cause trouble.」

177:t_1:23.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Being His Majesty the Emperor must be hard. I feel for him.」

177:t_1:24.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「How kind of you, $$バルビエル$$.」

177:t_1:25.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Do you want to make me angry that badly?」

177:t_1:27.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「As usual, you're making a disgraceful spectacle.」

177:t_1:29.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Shall we begin our reports, $$アウストラリス$$?」

177:t_1:34.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Briefing Room ～

177:t_1:36.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Now that the units have reunited, they're sharing information in the $$クォーター$$'s hangar. Shall we drop by, too?」

177:t_1:37.en:
$n
「Go to the hangar and hear about the other units」
「Don't go to the hangar」

177:t_1:39.en:
$n
「I hear there are new members, too. I ought to introduce myself.」

177:t_1:42.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's better than your smile, $n. People tell you your face is scary.」

177:t_1:44.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm kidding. I smiled because I'm happy to see how you've changed, $n.」

177:t_1:45.en:
$n
「Have I stopped being the quiet type!?」

177:t_1:46.en:
$$スズネ$$
(He's really eager... It must have been bothering him quite a bit.)

177:t_1:48.en:
$$スズネ$$
「W-well... Let's put that aside for now...」

177:t_1:51.en:
$n
「...Then I'll ask $$ボス$$ or $$木下$$ for some special training and...」

177:t_1:52.en:
$$スズネ$$
「T-that's enough...! You don't have to force yourself to change your personality...!」

177:t_1:55.en:
$$スズネ$$
「All right, all right. Let's go see everyone instead.」

177:t_1:57.en:
$$スズネ$$
(It's a good sign that he's becoming aware of his place among everyone. Maybe he won't be the quiet type much longer.)

177:t_1:58.en:
$$スズネ$$
(But I'll feel a little lonely if I'm no longer the only one he opens up to...)

177:t_1:61.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I-it's nothing! Let's hurry and go!」

177:t_1:66.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

177:t_1:68.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Though the situation isn't one we can celebrate without reservation.」

177:t_1:69.en:
$$甲児$$
「I hear the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ joined up with $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ right after we parted ways.」

177:t_1:70.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Yes. $$刹那$$ and all the other $$ガンダムマイスター$$s are safe.」

177:t_1:71.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then we learned from $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ that $$フル・フロンタル$$ had become $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s new leader, and we descended to North America.」

177:t_1:72.en:
$$さやか$$
「What did you go there for?」

177:t_1:73.en:
$$ファ$$
「North America is a fierce battleground where the Federation and Imperial forces are evenly matched.」

177:t_1:74.en:
$$フォウ$$
「We fought the Empire there while investigating $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s movements.」

177:t_1:75.en:
$$甲児$$
「Why does $$ネオ・ジオン$$ come into it?」

177:t_1:76.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The Empire isn't targeting space colonies. That raised suspicions that they and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ were colluding.」

177:t_1:78.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Unfortunately, it was true. We learned that when we fought $$ギュネイ$$ in North America.」

177:t_1:79.en:
$$ボス$$
「That guy... He's still with $$ネオ・ジオン$$...!」

177:t_1:80.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$ had hinted at cooperating with $$ジェミニス$$ during the $$時獄戦役$$, too.」

177:t_1:81.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Rescuing $$チェーン$$ from $$ジオン$$ captivity and recovering the $$νガンダム$$ were among the few gains from that battle.」

177:t_1:82.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Hold on, Captain $$アムロ$$! Don't forget about us.」

177:t_1:83.en:
$$甲児$$
「You joined up with them too, Lieutenant $$コーラサワー$$.」

177:t_1:84.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「You bet. On the Colonel's... I mean, the Brigadier General's orders.」

177:t_1:85.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Actually, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ wasn't the only group that joined forces with the Empire...」

177:t_1:86.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$クロノ$$ is still deeply rooted in the Federation military. Some of its forces are already cooperating with the Empire.」

177:t_1:88.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But not all Federation forces are with $$クロノ$$. Brigadier General $$カティ$$ is one example.」
